simple.prompt: Passive with modals: 'The confidential documents ___ under strict surveillance.'
simple.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + V3 ('must be kept').

simple.prompt: Present Continuous Passive: 'The highway ___ due to emergency roadworks.'
simple.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: to be (is/are) + being + V3 ('is being repaired').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif modal masa lalu 'should have been'.
simple.targetSentence: The client should have been notified earlier.
simple.explanation: Subject + should have been + past participle (notified) + earlier.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The client should have been'.

simple.prompt: Present Perfect Passive: 'Several unexpected vulnerabilities ___ in the new update.'
simple.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: have/has + been + V3 ('have been discovered').

simple.targetSentence: The suspect was being interrogated by detectives.
simple.explanation: Subject + was being interrogated + by detectives.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The suspect was being interrogated'.

simple.prompt: Future Passive: 'The newly constructed suspension bridge ___ next month.'
simple.explanation: Future Passive: will be + V3 ('will be inaugurated').
hints: Pasif masa depan: will be + V3.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif dengan dua objek.
simple.targetSentence: The scholarship was awarded to the top candidate.
simple.explanation: The scholarship (direct object) + was awarded to + the top candidate.
hints: Bentuk pasif: 'was awarded to the top candidate'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog passive reporting verbs (impersonal construction).
dialogue: What is the consensus regarding the merger?
It ___ that the acquisition will create thousands of jobs.
intermediate.explanation: Impersonal reporting passive: It + is/was + V3 (believed/reported/claimed) + that clause.
hints: Struktur impersonal: It is believed that...

intermediate.prompt: Personal reporting passive: 'The billionaire ___ to be negotiating the purchase of the football club.'
intermediate.explanation: Personal passive construction: Subject + is/are + V3 (rumored/thought/said) + to-infinitive.
hints: Subjek person + to be + V3 + to-infinitive.

intermediate.prompt: Causative passive: 'We need to ___ our financial statements audited by an independent firm.'
intermediate.explanation: Causative passive: have/get + something + V3 ('have our financial statements audited').
hints: Pola causative pasif: have + object + V3.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat personal passive dengan 'is said to be'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The ancient artifact is said to be cursed.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + is said to be + cursed (adjective/participle).
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'is said to be cursed'.

intermediate.prompt: Prepositional passive verbs: 'The elderly gentleman was well ___ by his hospice nurses.'
intermediate.explanation: Phrasal verbs dalam bentuk pasif mempertahankan preposisinya: 'was well looked after by...'.
hints: Preposisi 'after' harus tetap menempel pada kata kerja.

intermediate.targetSentence: She got her passport renewed before the trip.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + got + her passport (object) + renewed (V3) + before the trip.
hints: Mulai dengan 'She got her passport renewed'.

dialogue: He is understood ___ the border under an assumed identity.
intermediate.explanation: Ketika peristiwa pasif merujuk pada aksi yang sudah terjadi di masa lampau sebelum waktu pelaporan, gunakan Perfect Infinitive ('to have crossed').
hints: Aksi melintasi perbatasan terjadi sebelum pelaporan.

complex.draft: There is reported that several passengers sustained minor injuries.
options: It is reported that several passengers sustained minor injuries.
Passengers are reported that they sustained minor injuries.
That several passengers sustained minor injuries is reporting.
complex.explanation: Impersonal passive reporting menggunakan dummy pronoun 'It' (bukan There): 'It is reported that...'.

complex.prompt: Choose the correct transformation for past events into personal passive: 'People believe that Socrates drank hemlock.'
options: Socrates is believed to have drunk hemlock.
Socrates is believed to drink hemlock.
Socrates was believed to drink hemlock.
complex.explanation: Karena aksi (minum racun) terjadi sebelum waktu keyakinan saat ini (present belief), wajib memakai Perfect Infinitive: 'is believed to have drunk'.
hints: Aksi masa lalu dilaporkan pada masa kini.

complex.prompt: Passive gerunds and infinitives: 'The diplomat objected to ___ as a junior representative.'
complex.explanation: Setelah preposisi 'to' pada 'object to', kata kerja harus berbentuk Gerund. Dalam konteks pasif: 'being treated'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat passive dengan perfect infinitive 'is alleged to have embezzled'.
complex.targetSentence: The former CFO is alleged to have embezzled company funds.
complex.explanation: Subject + is alleged + to have embezzled (perfect infinitive) + company funds.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The former CFO is alleged'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'to have embezzled company funds'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kata kerja intransitif yang keliru dipasifkan.
complex.draft: An unfortunate traffic collision was happened on the expressway.
options: An unfortunate traffic collision happened on the expressway.
An unfortunate traffic collision was occurred on the expressway.
An unfortunate traffic collision was being happened on the expressway.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja intransitif seperti 'happen', 'occur', 'appear', dan 'exist' TIDAK MEMILIKI objek langsung, sehingga sama sekali TIDAK BISA dipasifkan. Wajib aktif: 'happened'.
hints: Kata kerja intransitif tidak bisa dipasifkan.

complex.prompt: Subtle register analysis: Why do scientific and academic research papers heavily favor passive constructions?
options: To establish an objective tone by foregrounding the methodology and findings rather than the researcher's ego.
Because active voice is grammatically prohibited in all journals.
To make the text artificially longer.
complex.explanation: Gaya penulisan akademik ilmiah mengutamakan proses eksperimen, metodologi, dan data hasil temuan (objectivity), bukan pelaku peneliti.
hints: Tujuan objektivitas dan fokus pada metodologi/hasil.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog persidangan dengan bentuk pasif yuridis formal.
dialogue: What is the status of the seized evidence?
The encrypted hard drives are deemed ___ by state forensic analysts.
complex.explanation: Bentuk pasif ganda dengan perfect infinitive: 'to have been tampered with' (dianggap telah dirusak).
hints: Bukti telah dimanipulasi di masa lalu.
